JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Humanoid Alien Races
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Humanoid Alien Races: the framework most custom humanoid races are built on (own bodies, graphics, stats, thoughts).
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.pitfall: Many alien races have their own body instead of the human one: code that expects human limbs and organs can miss parts or do needless work.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.advice: JB mods ask the framework's HAR adapter whether a race is custom-bodied and fall back to vanilla behaviour for it (Luciferium Overhaul does so by default).

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: NewRatkinPlus
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: NewRatkinPlus: the Ratkin, a small rat-eared humanoid race with factions, research, weapons and buildings (built on HAR).
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.pitfall: A player reported tick spikes with Ratkin and Luciferium Overhaul; they could not be reproduced (about 1 µs per tick).
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.advice: If it happens: Luciferium Overhaul's "Alien races use vanilla Luciferium healing" and its performance watchdog.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Vanilla Races Expanded - Android
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Vanilla Races Expanded - Android: buildable android colonists with hardware genes, powered by neutroamine.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Vanilla Races Expanded - Sanguophage
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Vanilla Races Expanded - Sanguophage: more vampire xenotypes, hemogen abilities and a hemogen pipe network.
